skill.description: Run a pre-commit quality and security pass and prepare a focused review request.

memory.responsibility: Retain local changes plus decisions, observations, and verification evidence needed to resume safely.

planning.responsibility: Transform security scan into the ordered, bounded stages defined by this skill.

action.responsibility: Advance the workflow through quality checks while preserving stop conditions and user authority.

capability.responsibility: Expose only repository, runtime, and verification capabilities required by the bounded engineering task.

stages: Request review with a focused brief

maturity.claim_boundary: This repository validates and plans the harness contract; it does not claim live service execution or benchmark gains without a connected adapter and measured evidence.
